screens.name: P0 — Global Status
screens.description: Live aggregate metrics for all active sensors and global flow animation.

screens.name: P1 — Instant Flow
screens.description: Live instantaneous flow rate (L/s) for all 8 sensors. Shows propeller animation when any sensor is active.

screens.name: P2 — Cumulative Liters
screens.description: Cumulative flow totals in litres for all 8 sensors. Long ENTER starts 30 s reset countdown.

screens.name: P3 — Cumulative m³
screens.description: Cumulative totals in cubic metres (derived from P2 registers).

screens.name: P4 — Session Liters
screens.description: Session flow totals in litres. Long ENTER starts 3 s countdown to reset session.

screens.name: P5 — Session m³
screens.description: Session totals in cubic metres (derived from P4 registers).

screens.name: P6 — Max Flow Since Reset
screens.description: Maximum flow rate since last reset for each sensor.

screens.name: P7 — Enter Configuration
screens.description: Text-only prompt to enter configuration mode. Short ENTER starts 3 s countdown.

screens.name: Countdown — Enter Config
screens.description: 3 s countdown overlay. If ENTER held to zero, transitions to configuration. Release early = cancel.

screens.name: Countdown — Reset Session
screens.description: 3 s countdown overlay for resetting session counters. Release ENTER to cancel.

screens.name: Countdown — Reset All Measured
screens.description: 30 s countdown overlay. Must hold ENTER throughout. Release early cancels.

screens.name: Factory Reset Countdown
screens.description: 30 s countdown for factory reset. Hold UP+DOWN throughout. Warning overlay after 3 s.

screens.name: Save & Validate Countdown
screens.description: 3s countdown for saving sensor settings with Nyquist validation.

screens.name: Exit Configuration Countdown
screens.description: 3s countdown to exit config. Release before 1.5s cancels; hold to 3s exits to idle.

screens.name: Nyquist Validation Warning
screens.description: Shown when f_theoretical exceeds Nyquist limit. UP=Edit, DOWN=Save anyway.

screens.name: Idle (display off)
screens.description: Backlight off state. Any button press returns to Info mode.

screens.name: C1 — Modbus Slave ID
screens.description: Configure the Modbus slave ID (1–255). Short ENTER edits, confirm to apply.

screens.name: C3 — Parity
screens.description: Select parity: None, Even, Odd. Displays UART frame summary e.g. 8E1.

screens.name: C4 — Stop Bits
screens.description: Toggle stop bits between 1 and 2.

screens.name: C5 — LED Pulse Volume
screens.description: Set the LED pulse volume trigger: 1 L, 10 L, or 100 L. Maps to Modbus register 31.

screens.name: C6 — LED Pulse Period
screens.description: Set the LED pulse period 100–2000 ms. Maps to Modbus register 32.

screens.name: C7 — Sensor Select
screens.description: Select sensor 1–8 to enter its sub-menu.

screens.name: S1 — Connected
screens.description: Toggle sensor connected state (inUse flag). Maps to Connected Sensors Bitmap.

screens.name: S2 — Multiplier (F)
screens.description: Set signed 16-bit multiplier for selected sensor. Maps to register 121.

screens.name: S3 — Adjust
screens.description: Set signed 16-bit adjustment offset for selected sensor. Maps to register 122.

screens.name: S4 — Max Flow (Q, L/min)
screens.description: Set max flow rate 0–65535 L/min for selected sensor. Maps to register 120.
